input.summary: I-house west room (parlour) built in parts/room-8.mjs as one layers() draw: lit furnace stove at x26 z12 on the chimney wall (stand x27 z12 clear), spruce settee of two stairs at x27 z14..15 facing a fence-and-top-slab table at x26 z14, barrel dresser at x26 z10, two hanging lanterns at y6 (27,12 and 26,14). make.sh is whole, the line shows 8 placed with no REFUSED or OFF-PALETTE; room light is 11+ on every floor cell, 0 dark; fit OK for this room.
left: Walk verdict is UNREACHABLE (0 of 11 cells) only because the entrance is outside the house: the front door (x29..30 z9) and the stair hall (room-9 and the door at x28 z11) are not built in this copy, so the path door x28 z11 -> x27 z11 -> stove stand x27 z12 -> settee could not be confirmed by the tool. Re-run $MCD room once parts room-9 and fittings are merged.

No shelf of trapdoors with pots and no rug: palette.json has no flower_pot, candle, decorated_pot or wool carpet, so the parlour has a barrel dresser only. A top-slab shelf on the west wall would need palette additions.

plan.md's floor grid shows x25 z12 as a doorway 'D' (the chimney footing is reserved as air). The chimneys part must fill x25 z12 so the stove has its chimney behind it; I did not place anything there.

plan.md's Notes have no per-room checklist, so nothing was ticked. elements.md's Plot 2 'stoves x26 z12' item is now built on my side (the furnace), but its beds and the x33 stove belong to other parts.

waste.what: Worked out each furniture cell and its facing by hand (stair facing east for a seat facing west, furnace front east, lantern heights) and tried several layouts in my head before drawing one.
waste.cost: about 6 coordinate passes before the first draw; no retries after the draw
waste.tool: A room-furnisher helper in the build library that takes a room box and a role list (stove on chimney wall, settee facing table, dresser) and returns the layers() rows with facings already set and the stand cells kept clear.

waste.what: Checked walkability by reading the 'x' marks on the floor grid because the entrance is outside the house and the hall is unbuilt, so the tool cannot test the real path from the door.
waste.cost: one room check plus a manual read of the grid
waste.tool: mcd room with an --entry option (a floor cell such as x28 z11 that counts as a way in), so a single room can be tested before its hall exists.

waste.what: Working out which palette items exist for a parlour (no flower pot, candle, carpet) by reading palette.json against the trade text.
waste.cost: one pass over the palette and a few decisions dropped (shelf of pots, rug)
waste.tool: A palette check that lists which trade-standard furnishings (flower_pot, candle, carpet, lectern) are missing before the furnisher starts.

companions.task: Place and check the two hanging lanterns and the lit stove so the room has no dark cell and the focal stove sits in the brightest light; I placed them by the mcd room light map, but a lamplighter would have set the lamp layout.
Confirm the settee stairs are a seat in the room, not a step, and that their heights match the stair flight in the hall next door.
Fill the chimney footing at x25 z12 so the stove has its chimney behind it, and the plan's doorway mark there goes away.
